title: formatTime
responsibility: Formats recorded instants consistently while retaining calendar labels and missing-value fallbacks.

inputs.name: formatTime.instant
inputs.description: String instant to format, or `null` when unavailable; a falsy value or non-finite `Date.parse` result returns the fallback.

inputs.name: formatTime.fallback
inputs.description: Fallback text returned for a falsy or unparseable instant; when omitted, it defaults to `instant ?? 'Unknown'` (the original instant when non-null, otherwise `Unknown`).

inputs.name: formatTime.style
inputs.description: `compact` formats valid instants with a medium date and short time, while `full` uses the runtime default date/time options. Style affects only valid instants because missing or invalid values return the fallback.

inputs.name: timeLabel.recorded
inputs.description: Recorded date, calendar label, or timestamp text; only strings beginning with the `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` digit pattern are passed to `formatTime`. Other text is returned unchanged, and invalid matching timestamps remain unchanged because the wrapper supplies the recorded text as fallback.

inputs.name: displayTime.instant
inputs.description: Instant for revision details, or `null` when unavailable. The wrapper uses `Unknown` for falsy or unparseable values and the default compact style for valid instants.

outputs.name: formatTime
outputs.description: Localized date/time for a truthy instant accepted by `Date.parse`, or the fallback for a falsy or unparseable instant. Formatting uses the runtime default locale and time zone; `compact` selects medium date and short time, while `full` uses default `toLocaleString` options.

outputs.name: timeLabel
outputs.description: Localized date/time when the recorded text matches the timestamp prefix and parses to a finite date; otherwise, the original text. Timestamp formatting uses the runtime default locale and time zone.

outputs.name: displayTime
outputs.description: Localized compact date/time for a valid instant, or `Unknown` for a falsy or unparseable instant. Formatting uses the runtime default locale and time zone.
